Name: Camera roll
Description: Set the additional native roll angle of the held free camera. Enable free camera first. The setting ends when camera ownership or the scene changes.
RestoreBehavior: Held roll is released with free camera. Native follow resumes its own pose; no camera bank is restored.

Evidence.Finding: Camera+120 is an additional roll angle in radians, applied to the view after eye/target/up.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Camera owner
Description: Native camera owner: 0 normal follow, 1 scripted camera, 2 observed minigame control. Other values are not classified.
RestoreBehavior: Read only. Availability follows the current camera and field scene.

Evidence.Finding: Camera owner is int32 at RVA AC1528, separate from the bank and controller mode.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Follow controller mode
Description: Native field camera branch. Mode 0 is normal follow; other branches may belong to aiming, tracking or scripted actions.
RestoreBehavior: Read only. Availability follows the current camera and field scene.

Evidence.Finding: The field controller dispatches its int32 mode at RVA 718CA8.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Recenter behind player
Description: Queue the native recenter behind the followed player and restore its preset follow distance. Requires the normal camera, a living current player and no menu, event or transition.
RestoreBehavior: Pending request is canceled on timeout, disconnect or camera/player/scene ownership loss. Executed native recenter/snap is a one-time action.

Evidence.Finding: Request byte+65 is set immediately before the next normal follow task and consumed during that update.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Snap camera interpolation
Description: Queue one native camera snap to its current desired pose. Requires normal follow and free camera disabled. This does not change the player or camera owner.
RestoreBehavior: Pending request is canceled on timeout, disconnect or camera/player/scene ownership loss. Executed native recenter/snap is a one-time action.

Evidence.Finding: Request byte+64 is consumed by the ordinary field camera update before smoothing.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Pending camera action
Description: 0 none, 1 recenter queued, 2 camera snap queued. Requests expire after 1.5 seconds or when player, scene, ownership or connection changes.
RestoreBehavior: Read only. Availability follows the current camera and field scene.

Evidence.Finding: The trainer queues a request for the existing group 1, priority 26000 camera task; it does not run an extra camera update.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Camera follows current player
Description: Whether the native field controller currently holds the freshly validated player pointer.
RestoreBehavior: Read only. Availability follows the current camera and field scene.

Evidence.Finding: The borrowed followed-actor pointer is at RVA 718CB0 and is cleared by player teardown.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Native follow distance
Description: Read the native follow distance parameter. Collision and interpolation can make the rendered eye-to-target distance different.
RestoreBehavior: Read only. Availability follows the current camera and field scene.

Evidence.Finding: Controller+88 is the native distance input, bounded by controller+212/+216 in the zoom input path.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and static control-flow review; synthetic guard tests passed. Live camera validation is pending.

Name: Eye to target distance
Description: Read the geometric distance from the rendered camera eye to its target point. This is not an optical depth of field setting.
RestoreBehavior: Read only. Availability follows the current camera and field scene.

Evidence.Finding: Camera+72/+88 hold eye and target vectors used to build the view.
